title: Dental Classification System
oneLiner: Containerized Streamlit app running custom-trained YOLO inference on dental images.
objective: Build a web-based dental image classification system with a custom-trained YOLO model and a professional Streamlit interface for real-time inference and annotation.
achievements: Built an interactive Streamlit app with a clean UI for uploading dental images and running real-time YOLO inference.
Integrated a custom-trained YOLO model with configurable confidence thresholds and automated bounding-box annotation.
Deployed a containerized build with headless OpenCV for Streamlit Cloud compatibility and cross-platform reproducibility.
